title: SPEAK INTO YOUR WEEK BEFORE THE ENEMY DOES
text: Beloved, before we begin this morning, I want you to do something significant. Share this prayer with someone. Don't just keep it to [music] yourself. There are people in your sphere of influence who need to hear what the spirit of God is about to release. Your brother, your sister, your colleague, that friend who has been going through turbulence. Send this to them. The enemy fights what he fears. And he fears the agreement of [music] the saints in prayer. When you share this, you are not just forwarding a message. You are becoming a distribution center of divine ammunition. You are arming the body of Christ for warfare. So right now as the uncction of the Holy Ghost begins to settle upon this atmosphere. Share this with at least three people. Let the sound of prophetic declaration go viral in the realm of the spirit. The Bible says in Psalm 68 to11, "The Lord gave the word. Great was the company of those that published it. Publish this word. Release it into your networks. And as you do, may the grace that rest upon this ministry overshadow you in the name of Jesus. Now listen to me very carefully this morning. I'm speaking under the inspiration of the Holy Ghost. And I want you to receive this not as the word of man, but as it is in truth, the word of the living God. The title of our focus is clear and precise. Speak into your week before the enemy does. There is a spiritual principle that many believers have not understood. And because of this ignorance, they live perpetually on the defense instead of [music] the offense. The Bible makes it clear in Ephesians 6:12 that we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against [music] powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. This means that there is an active intentional calculated assault being orchestrated in the invisible realm against your destiny, against your weak, against your progress. And if you do not take your place as a royal priesthood, as a prophetic voice, as an oracle of the most high God, the enemy will feel the silence with his narrative. I want you to understand something this morning. Silence in the spirit realm is not neutrality. It is vacancy. And every vacancy in the spirit becomes an opportunity for occupation. When you do not speak, something else speaks. When you do not prophesy, something else prophesies. [music] When you do not decree, something else decrees. The enemy understands the principle of first access. Whoever speaks first into the week, into the month, into the season, establishes the spiritual tone. This is why you must wake up with prophetic intentionality. You cannot afford to be casual about Monday morning. You cannot afford to roll out of bed without engaging the realm of the spirit. You are not an accident. You are not a mere biological creature trying to survive the week. You are a spirit being created in the image and likeness of God endowed with the authority to frame your world with the word of your mouth. Look at Genesis chapter 1. Before God created anything, he spoke. He said, "Let there be light." And light appeared. He said, "Let the waters be gathered together, and it was so." Everything you see in the physical realm was first a sound in the spirit realm. God frame the words with words. Hebrews 11:3 says, "Through faith, we understand that the words were framed by the word of God." So that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear. The visible came out of the invisible and the invisible was activated by speech. So when you wake up on Monday morning and you say nothing, when you walk into your week in silence, when you go about your day without prophetic engagement, you have abdicated your governmental responsibility, you have left the microphone open. And I can assure you demonic forces do not sleep. They are monitoring. They are waiting. They are ready to inject fear, to inject limitation, to inject confusion, to inject sickness, to inject lack, to inject frustration into the atmosphere of your weak. But I have come to announce to you this morning that your mouth is a weapon, your tongue is a weapon. Proverbs 18:21 declares that death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof. This means that every time you open your mouth, you are either releasing life or you are releasing death. You are either blessing or cursing. You are either building or destroying. And the tragedy is that many believers use their mouths carelessly. They wake up and the first thing they say is, "I'm so tired. This week is going to be stressful. I don't know how I'm going to make it. Things are so hard." And they wonder why their week unfolds exactly as they have spoken. You are not a reporter. You are a creator. You are not supposed to describe what you see. You are supposed to decree what you desire in alignment with the will of God. Now I need to make a distinction here because there are people who will misunderstand this and turn it into some kind of name it claim it foolishness. I am not talking about positive thinking. I am not talking about motivational speaking. I am talking about prophetic declaration that is rooted in the revealed will of God that is backed by the authority of the blood of Jesus that is energized by the power of the Holy Ghost. You cannot just say anything and expect it to happen. Your words must be aligned with scripture. Your words must be soaked in prayer. Your words must come from a place of intimacy with the father. This is not about manipulating God. This is about partnering with God. This is about taking the prophetic scripts that he has already written concerning your life and giving them voice in the earth. Let me show you something powerful. In the book of Ezekiel chapter 37, the prophet Ezekiel was brought into a valley full of dry bones. These bones were very dry. They represented a hopeless situation, a dead situation, a situation that looked irreversible. And God asked Ezekiel a question, "Son of man, can these bones leave? Now if Ezekiel had responded based on what he saw, he would have said no. But he said, "Oh Lord God, thou knowest." And then God gave him an instruction. He said, "Prophesy upon these bones [music] and say unto them, oh ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord." Now catch this. God did not tell Ezekiel to pray about the bones. He did not tell him to fast about the bones. He told him to prophesy to the bones. And as Ezekiel prophesied, there was a noise, a shaking, and the bones came together. Flesh came upon them, skin covered them, but they had no breath. Then God said, "Prophesy unto the wind. And as Ezekiel prophesied to the wind, breath entered them, and they stood up an exceeding great army." This is the power of prophetic utterance. There are dead things in your life that are waiting for your voice. There are dry situations in your career, in your finances, in your relationships, in your health that are waiting for you to prophesy. The problem is that you have been praying in silence. You have been hoping in silence. You have been wishing in silence. But God is saying this morning, open your mouth. Speak to the situation. Command the bones to leave. Decree alignment. Decree restoration. Decree acceleration. decrease supernatural provision. This is not arrogance. This is authority. An authority that is not [music] exercised becomes authority that is not experienced. I want to take you to another scripture. In Mark 11:23, Jesus said, "For verily I say unto you, that whosoever shall say unto this mountain, be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea, and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass, he shall have whatsoever he saith." Did you catch that? Jesus did [music] not say, "Whosoever shall pray about this mountain." He said, "Whosoever shall say unto this mountain, there is a dimension of prayer that is declaration, there is a dimension of intercession, that is confrontation. You do not negotiate with a mountain. You do not dialogue with a mountain. You command the mountain. And whatever mountain is standing between you and your prophetic destiny this week, you have the authority in the name of Jesus to speak to it and command it to be removed." Now, let me show you how the enemy operates. The enemy is a legalist. He understands spiritual law better than most Christians. He knows that he cannot just do anything he wants in your life. He needs legal access. He needs permission. He needs an opening. And one of the ways he gains access is through negative confession, through fearfilled declarations, through word curses that you pronounce upon yourself. When you say, "I always get sick this time of the year," you are giving the enemy a legal right to afflict you. When you say money never stays in my hand, you are opening the door to the spirit of poverty. When you say I can never succeed at this, you are erecting a mental and spiritual barrier against your breakthrough. The enemy takes your words and uses them as evidence in the courtroom of the spirit. He says, look, this person has agreed with me. They have confessed limitation. They have prophesied failure. Therefore, I have the right to enforce it. But glory be to God, the same principle works in reverse. When you begin to speak the word of God, when you begin to declare the promises of scripture, when you begin to prophesy life and victory and breakthrough, you are building a legal case for the manifestation of God's goodness in your life. You are giving the Holy Spirit something to work with. You are giving the angels something to enforce. Psalm 103-20 says, "Bless the Lord, ye his angels that excel in strength that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word." The angels hearken to the voice of God's word. When you speak God's word, angels go to work. When you speak doubt and fear, you tie the hands of heavenly assistance. So this morning I want to teach you how to speak into your week before the enemy does. First you must sanctify your morning. The morning is the gateway to the day. What happens in the morning sets the trajectory for the rest of the day. This is why the Bible says in Psalm 5:3, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." The psalmist understood the power of [music] morning consecration. He understood that the first fruits of his time, the first fruits of his attention, the first fruits of his voice must be given to God. When you wake up and the first thing you do is grab your phone and start scrolling through social media, you have just invited the world's [music] narrative into your spirit before you have invited God's narrative. When you wake up and the first thing you do is turn on the news and hear all the negativity, the crime, the inflation, the disasters, you are downloading fear and anxiety before you have downloaded faith and peace. I am telling you by the spirit of God, establish a morning altar. Before you check your email, before you check your WhatsApp, before you do anything else, spend time in the presence of God. Pray in tongues, worship, read the scriptures, and then begin to speak prophetically over your day. Say, "Father, I thank you that this is the day that the Lord has made. I will rejoice and be glad in it. I declare that this day is loaded with divine appointments. I declare that favor surrounds me like a shield. I declare that the angels of the Lord are encamped around me. I declare that no weapon formed against me shall [music] prosper. I declare that I walk in supernatural wisdom. I declare that doors of opportunity are opened unto me that no man can shut. I declare that I am the head and not the tail, above only and not beneath. I declare that the Lord is my shepherd. I shall not want. Do you see what you are doing? You are setting the spiritual climate. You are establishing the atmosphere. You are framing your world. And when the enemy shows up with his assignment of discouragement, he finds that the atmosphere has already been occupied. He finds that there is no vacancy. He finds that prophetic declarations have already been released and he has no legal ground to stand on. Secondly, you must understand the power of prophetic prayer. Prophetic prayer is not just asking God for things. Prophetic prayer is agreeing with what God has already said and releasing it into the earth. It is taking the blueprints of heaven and enforcing them on earth. Jesus taught us to pray, "Thy kingdom come, thy will be done in earth as it is in heaven." This is a governmental prayer. This is a prayer of alignment. This is a prayer that says, "God, whatever you have ordained in the heavenly realm, let it manifest in the earthly realm." And the way you enforce this is through decree. Let me give you an example. The Bible says in Jeremiah 29:11, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, sayeth the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you an expected end." Now, that is God's thought. That is God's plan. That is God's intention. But it does not automatically happen just because [music] God taught it. You must take that thought, that promise, and give it voice. You must say, "Father, I thank you that your thoughts toward me are thoughts of peace and not of evil. I declare that my expected end is manifesting. I declare that every plan of the enemy to truncate my destiny is null and void. I declare that I am walking in the fullness of your purpose for my life." When you do that, you are not begging God. You are not trying to convince God. You are enforcing what God has already established. Thirdly, you must be consistent. The enemy is consistent. [music] He does not take a day off. He does not say, "Oh, it's the weekend. Let me relax." No, he is relentless. He's persistent. He's calculating. And if you are only praying when you feel like it, if you are only declaring when you are in trouble, you are giving him the upper hand. You must build a lifestyle [music] of prophetic declaration. every morning, every week, every month, every season, you must speak into it before the enemy does. This is not a one-time event. This is a lifestyle. This is a discipline. This is a spiritual habit that separates those who thrive from those who merely [music] survive. I remember many years ago, the Lord taught me this principle in a very profound way. I was going through a season where everything seemed to be falling apart. My finances were under attack. My health was under attack. Relationships were under attack. And one morning as I was praying, the Holy Spirit said to me, "You have been silent [music] too long. The enemy has been speaking and you have been listening. It is time for you to speak and for the enemy to listen." And I began to engage in what I call militant prophetic declarations. Every morning I would wake up and spend at least one hour just decreeing the word of God over [music] my life, over my family, over my ministry, over my finances, over my health. I would declare Psalm 91. I would declare Psalm 23. I would declare Deuteronomy 28. I [music] would declare Isaiah 54. And I'm telling you, within a matter of weeks, I began to see a shift. Things that had been stagnant began to move. Doors that had been closed began to open. Enemies that had been rising began to fall. Why? Because I took my place as a prophetic voice. I refuse to let the enemy have the microphone. Now, let me address something that is very important. Some of you are wondering, but I've been praying. I've been declaring. I've been speaking [music] and nothing is happening. Let me tell you something. The fact that you do not see immediate results does not mean your words are not working. Faith is not governed by sight. Faith is governed by the word of God. Hebrews 11:1 says, "Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen." The moment you speak God's word in faith, something happens in the spirit realm. It may not manifest immediately in the physical realm, but there is a spiritual transaction [music] that has taken place. The angels have been dispatched. The enemy has been restrained. The blessing [music] has been released. And it is only a matter of time before what has been established in [music] the spirit becomes visible in the natural. I want you to understand that delay is not denial. Delay is often preparation. God is positioning things. God is aligning people. God is removing obstacles. God is maturing you to handle what he's about to release. So do not grow weary in welloing. Do not stop declaring because you do not see results yet. Galatians 6:9 says, "And let us not be weary in welloing, for in due season we shall reap if we faint not." The harvest is coming. The breakthrough is coming. The manifestation is coming. But you must remain steadfast. You must remain consistent. You must continue to speak into your week, into your month, into your season before the enemy does. Let me also talk about the principle of spiritual warfare. The moment you begin to speak prophetically, you are engaging the enemy. You are entering into combat and the enemy will resist. HE WILL FIGHT BACK. You may begin to experience unusual attacks. You may begin to experience distractions. You may begin to experience fear. This is not a sign that your declarations are not working. This is a sign that they are working and the enemy is threatened. The Bible says in Daniel chapter 10 that when Daniel prayed, his words were heard from the first day. But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withtood the angel for 21 days. There was a delay. There was resistance. There was warfare. But the breakthrough eventually came. So when you declare and things seem to get worse before they get better. Do not panic. Do not retreat. Do not stop speaking. Intensify your declarations. Intensify your prayer. Intensify your worship. The enemy only fights what he fears. And he fears your voice. He fears your authority. [music] He fears your faith. So press in. Push through. The breakthrough is closer than you think. Now, let me give you some practical declarations that you can begin to use as you speak into your week. These are not formulas. These are not magic words. These are biblical truths that you can personalize and release over your life. You can modify them. You can expand them. But the key is that you speak them with faith, with conviction, with authority. Declare, I serve a God [music] who is faithful. He has never failed and he will not start with me. This week, I walk in divine favor. Favor surrounds me like a shield. Every door that needs to open for me is opening. Every connection I need is being orchestrated by the Holy Spirit. Every resource I need is being released. I am not struggling. I am not striving. I am flowing in the grace of God. The Lord is my shepherd. I do not lack anything. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my [music] soul. He prepares a table before me in the presence of my enemies. My cup runs over. Surely goodness and mercy follow me all the days of my life. Declare, "No weapon formed against me shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I condemn. This is my heritage as a servant of the Lord. My righteousness is of the Lord. I am covered by the blood of Jesus. I am hidden in Christ. I am seated with him in heavenly places. I operate from a place of victory, not a place of defeat. The enemy is under my feet. I have been given authority to trample on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy and nothing shall by any means hurt me. Declare this week I am walking in supernatural wisdom. The spirit of wisdom and revelation rest upon me. I make decisions that are aligned with the will of God. I avoid every trap. I discern every scheme of the enemy. I am led by the spirit of God. He guides me into all truth. He shows me things to come. My steps are ordered by the Lord. I do not make mistakes. I do not miss divine appointments. I am in the right place at the right time, doing the right thing with the right people. Declare, my finances are blessed. The windows of heaven are open over my life. The Lord rebukes the divorake. My seed produces a harvest. What I sow comes back to me pressed down, shaken together, running over. I am a lender and not a borrower. I have more than enough to meet my needs and to be a blessing to others. Money is not my problem. Lack is not my portion. I operate in the covenant of abundance. The wealth of the wicked is laid up for me, the righteous. Declare, my family is covered by the blood of Jesus. My spouse is blessed. My children are blessed. My parents are blessed. My siblings are blessed. Psalm 91 is activated over my household. No evil befalls us. No plague comes near our dwelling. The Lord has given his angels charge over us to keep us in all our ways. We are protected. We are preserved. We are perfected in love. We walk in unity. We walk in peace. We walk in purpose. Declare, "My health is excellent. By the stripes of Jesus, I am healed. Sickness has no dominion over me. Disease has no power over me. My body is the temple of the Holy Ghost. Every organ functions properly. Every system functions properly. I am strong. I am vibrant. I am full of energy. I run and I do not grow weary. I walk and I do not faint." The Lord renews my strength like the eagle. Declare this week I am a blessing. Everywhere I go I carry the presence of God. I am the light of the world. I am the salt of the earth. People are drawn to the Christ in me. I am a solution provider. I am a problem solver. I add value. I make an impact. I live every place better than I found it. I am not a consumer. I am a contributor. I am not a victim. I am a victor. These declarations are powerful, but they only work when you believe them. When you speak them with conviction, when you back them up with a lifestyle of obedience and intimacy with God. You cannot live a canal life and expect spiritual results. You cannot be in disobedience and expect divine intervention. You cannot be harboring sin and expect supernatural breakthroughs. The Bible says in Psalm 66 to18, "If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me." Your declarations must be supported by a clean heart, a pure conscience, a consecrated life. So, as you speak into your week, make sure you are also living right. Make sure you [music] are walking in integrity. Make sure you are honoring God with your time, your talent, your treasure, your temple. Make sure you are in right relationship with people. The Bible says in Matthew 5:23 2:4, "Therefore, if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and their remembrance that thy brother hath ought against thee, leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way. First be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift. Unforgiveness blocks your prayers. Bitterness blocks your blessings. Offense [music] blocks your overflow. So deal with those issues, forgive quickly, release quickly, let go quickly, and watch how God begins to move on your behalf. I want to close with this. The week ahead of you is not empty. It is pregnant with possibilities. It is loaded with divine appointments. It is filled with opportunities for breakthrough, for promotion, for increase, for expansion. But whether you experience those things or not depends largely on what you do in the spirit realm. You can let the weak happen to you or you can happen to the weak. You can be reactive or you can be proactive. You can be a victim or you can be a victor. The choice is yours. So I am charging you this morning, speak your weak before the enemy does. Do not leave your weak to chance. Do not leave your weak to fate. Take authority. Take dominion. Take your place as a [music] prophetic voice every morning. Declare the goodness of God every morning. Release the promises of scripture every morning. Command your day to align with the will of heaven. And as you do, you will begin to see a transformation. You will begin to see shifts. You will begin to see breakthroughs that defy human explanation. In the mighty name of Jesus, I decree over your life right now that this week [music] is your week of supernatural turnaround. Every attack is reversed. Every delay is cancelled. Every limitation is broken. Every door is opened. Every mountain is removed. Every enemy is defeated. You are walking in favor. You are walking in grace. You are walking in [music] victory. The Lord is going before you to make the crooked places straight. He's breaking in pieces the gates of brass. [music] He's cutting in sunder the bars of iron. He's giving you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places. I prophesy acceleration over your career. I prophesy multiplication over your finances. I prophesy restoration over your relationships. I prophesy healing over your body. I prophesy peace over your mind. I prophesy joy over your spirit. This is your season. This is your time. This is your moment. And nothing, absolutely nothing shall be impossible unto you because you believe. Now, lift up your voice and begin to thank God. Begin to worship him. Begin to magnify his name for he's worthy. He's faithful. And he will do exactly what he has promised. Amen. And amen.
